steps.title: Open Tapeology
steps.narration: Start on the Cockpit, the screen where a stock's tape is actually watched.
steps.point_out: The data-source control at top-left, already set to Simulated.

steps.title: Pick the practice ticker
steps.narration: Type SIM-BUYER, the app's built-in practice ticker, into the Ticker field.
steps.point_out: The Ticker field now reads SIM-BUYER.

steps.title: An honest "nothing here" instead of a fake zone
steps.narration: Click Watch. SIM-BUYER is a made-up practice ticker with no real trading history behind it, so there's no real price zone to show for it — and Tapeology says so plainly instead of guessing.
steps.point_out: Right below the live chart, a small note reads "No tradable map for SIM-BUYER." — never a fabricated line.

steps.title: Switch to a real trading day
steps.narration: Click Historical to replay a real recorded trading session instead of a simulation.
steps.point_out: The controls change to a real symbol search plus a date and time window.

steps.title: Pick a real stock
steps.narration: Type AAPL into the symbol search.
steps.point_out: The Symbol field now reads AAPL.

steps.title: Pick the day
steps.narration: Type in a real June trading day.

steps.title: Fill the whole session in one click
steps.narration: Click the Full RTH quick-pick to fill in the entire regular trading session automatically.
steps.point_out: The start and end time fields fill in for you.

steps.title: The tradable wall, live on the chart
steps.narration: Click Watch to start replaying that real session. This time the chart also draws the stock's own short list of important price zones directly over the candles — the same zones the Structure page maps out, now visible at the exact moment and place a trade would be watched.
steps.point_out: Solid rose and green lines appear on the chart near $300 — real support and resistance zones, not simulated ones. When price sits right on one of these lines and the live tape reading agrees, a small descriptive note also appears just below the chart.

steps.title: Visit where the map is built
steps.narration: Head over to the Structure page — the research view where these price zones are worked out in the first place.
steps.point_out: The top navigation, unchanged, with Structure as one of its five pages.

steps.title: Pick the same stock
steps.narration: Type AAPL into the Symbol field.
steps.point_out: The Symbol field now reads AAPL.

steps.title: Pick the same moment
steps.narration: Enter that same June session as an as-of time.
steps.point_out: The As-of field now reads the chosen date and time.

steps.title: The same short list, still intact
steps.narration: Click Load. This is the very same short, ranked list of price zones the cockpit chart just drew — nothing about this page moved when the cockpit gained its new view.
steps.point_out: A short, ranked list of price zones tops the page, with the $300–$302 zone still near the top.
